title: Constrained Nested-Logit Pricing: An Exact Reformulation and Global Optimization Method
abstract: arXiv:2611.09023v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sellers must price substitutable products while meeting operational requirements such as price limits and sales targets. Nested logit captures stronger substitution among similar products, but these requirements can undermine the structure used to solve unconstrained pricing problems. We develop an exact reformulation and a global optimization method for a fixed assortment with price bounds and weighted price caps. The key novelty is to concentrate the difficult interactions at the nest level while retaining convex optimization over individual products, without discretizing prices or approximating demand. This structure makes the number of nests, rather than products, govern the exponent in a conditional worst-case complexity bound. The method returns feasible prices together with a bound on how much profit could still be gained, allowing decision makers to assess solution quality even when computation stops early. translated_title: 受约束的嵌套Logit定价：一种精确重构与全局优化方法
translated_abstract: 卖家在为可替代产品定价时，必须同时满足价格上下限、销售目标等运营要求。嵌套Logit模型能够刻画相似产品之间更强的替代效应，但这些约束条件可能破坏求解无约束定价问题时所依赖的结构。我们针对固定商品集合、带价格界限和加权价格上限的情形，开发了一种精确重构方法与全局优化方法。其关键创新在于将复杂的交互作用集中在嵌套层面，同时在单个产品层面保持凸优化，而无需对价格进行离散化或对需求进行近似。这一结构使得决定条件最坏情形复杂度界中指数的是嵌套数量，而非产品数量。该方法在返回可行定价方案的同时，还给出剩余可获利润的界，使决策者即使在计算提前终止的情况下也能评估解的质量。扩展部分涵盖了购…
tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对带价格界限与加权价格上限约束的嵌套Logit定价问题的精确重构与全局优化方法，通过将困难交互集中在嵌套层面并在产品层面保持凸优化，无需价格离散化或需求近似即可求解，且能给出剩余利润界以评估解的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an exact reformulation and global optimization method for nested-logit pricing with price bounds and weighted price caps, concentrating difficult interactions at the nest level while retaining per-product convex optimization—without discretizing prices or approximating demand—and returning a bound on remaining profit to assess solution quality.
